source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.group: Death Company Marines with Bolt Rifles
data.summary: This unit's **Charge rolls** may be re-rolled. Using the **[Fire Overwatch](vsdata:ability/core.fire-overwatch)** or **[Heroic Intervention](vsdata:ability/core.heroic-intervention)** Stratagem on this unit costs 1 CP less.

lastPrinted.note: Build 963, in force at this version's cutoff, no longer prints the Death Company Marines with Bolt Rifles datasheet; this rule is as build 946, the last to print it, gives it.
